metadata.analysisTemporalGrid: Source integer frame indices; every source frame, no synthetic detections
metadata.joints3dSpace: Body-centered camera axes rotated to Blender: x screen-right, y camera depth, z up. Meters predicted by model, not calibrated on field.
limitations: Broadcast replay is slow motion: no real-world speed inference.
Depth, contacts and occluded joints are monocular estimates.
No calibrated field homography or measured ball launch elevation.
Confidence fields null because this output does not provide calibrated joint confidence.

mediaAlignment.method: First CRF17 clip frame matched to original source frame 2422 by 320x180 mean absolute RGB difference.

metadata.pipelineDescription: SAM 3.1 con inferencia independiente en los 342 fotogramas (resolución interna de 384 px, fuente de 720p). Se aceptaron 217 máscaras y se estimaron 217 poses con SAM 3D Body. Se revisaron 38 posiciones en 16 fotogramas consecutivos del remate. La reconstrucción utiliza un rig MHR de 127 huesos; la profundidad permanece estimada.
metadata.reviewDescription: 16 fotogramas consecutivos del remate, revisados uno a uno. Se ajustaron 38 posiciones en la muñeca derecha y los tobillos. En el contacto, la muñeca estimada se había asignado al defensor: la revisión la devuelve al brazo de Quiñones. Los puntos ocultos conservan la estimación original, sin presentarse como observados.
metadata.motionScope: Only the contiguous observed interval containing the contact is animated in3D. Full source replay remains available. No missing-player motion is invented.
metadata.ballSegmentationLabel: SAM 3.1 · 35 máscaras independientes · recortes guiados por 13 observaciones manuales
metadata.cinematicScope: MuJoCo physical reconstruction, with its own assumed timing and generic articulated body. See physics/film-timing.json.
metadata.sourceEncoding: 720p H264 CRF17, source frame alignment retained.

ball.method: Manual visual annotation after inspecting extracted real frames using view_image; coordinates are approximate image measurements, not model detections. No coordinates assigned when center is hidden.

sampling.timeDefinition: sourceTime = sourceFrame * 1001/30000; clipTime = (sourceFrame - 2422) * 1001/30000; sourceFrame is zero-based.
sampling.sheets: 2 columns x3 rows; each tile640x360; source coordinate=2*(sheet coordinate minus tile origin). Tile order left-to-right then top-to-bottom.

contact.evidenceLayout: 3 columns x2 rows, order left-to-right/top-to-bottom. Cropped source x600 y450 width340 height240, enlarged 1.5x.
contact.note: Contacto se observa en intervalo de varios fotogramas. Marca central88.822s aproxima el contacto; no equivale a un instante medido con sensor.

camera.observation: No hard cut observed over88.0–90.3s. Additional check90.4–90.9s shows camera reframing/pan/zoom toward goal with post entering left; do not assume static camera.

limitations: Broadcast replay is slow motion; playback timestamps are not real-world action time.
Broadcast match clock keeps advancing during replay and does not time the original action.
Coordinates include camera pan/zoom; no camera motion compensation or metric calibration was performed.
Radius is apparent radius in image, not ball physical size or depth measurement.
No speed in m/s is measured or inferred.
Any3D trajectory must label depth and projection/reconstruction assumptions as inferred; 2D points alone do not supply measured depth.
Do not interpolate hidden samples and present them as observations.
Small printed ball symbols in the advertising panel are not the tracked ball.

ball.confidenceMeaning: Subjective annotation confidence, not a calibrated statistical probability. ErrorPx is a rough visual tolerance, not validated measurement error.

mediaAlignment.method: First encoded clip frame matched to source frame2422 by image difference: mean RGB difference1.877 vs19.908 for2421 and20.220 for2423 (320x180).

manualReview.frame_selection: Exact zero-based decoded frame index via ffmpeg select eq(n,N), not timestamp seeking. Full original1280x720 source used.
manualReview.annotation_method: Direct visual inspection of all16 consecutive frames with source crops; each target was drawn back on its own crop and visually checked. No interpolation of hidden landmarks. Coordinates are approximate visible-feature proxies for internal anatomical joints.

identity_correction.reason: This hanging arm connects to the defender white/blue sleeve, not Quiñones. Quiñones right arm is dark and extends horizontally across the defender torso.

usage: Targets are image-plane estimates, not measured3D joints.
Keep absent targets unchanged from model; do not silently fill nulls or present interpolated values as observations.
For IK use original model depth/limb constraints; label correction as an estimated2D-guided adjustment.
Pixel tolerances are visual uncertainty, not statistically calibrated accuracy.
Replay is slow motion; do not infer real-world velocities from source timestamps.

ballSegmentation.frame_selection: Independent SAM inference on every source frame 2637–2670 (34 frames), plus partly visible ball at 2679. Frames 2671–2678 remain absent.
ballSegmentation.model: SAM 3.1 MLX, 4-bit affine checkpoint, 384 px input crops
ballSegmentation.manual_support: The13original manual center/radius annotations guide the crops. Crop centers/radii are interpolated only to locate each intermediate crop. Interpolated crop guides are not observations. Every saved silhouette comes from an independent SAM3.1 prediction.

ball3d.method: Display-only screen-plane lift using body image height; depth fixed at inferred left-ankle depth at contact; no metric camera calibration. Hidden ball positions are not interpolated.
